# fossa Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "fossa" {
  # api_token can also be supplied via the FOSSA_API_TOKEN environment variable
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) FOSSA API token. Can also be set via the `FOSSA_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the FOSSA API. Defaults to `https://app.fossa.com/api`.
